run_evaluate_sort: run the evaluate function to benchmark a Rust sorting algorithm implementation
run_evaluate_cli: run the evaluator module from the command line with a Rust source file path as argument
test_evaluate_correctness: test a Rust sorting algorithm for correctness across different data patterns
review_evaluate_metrics: review the evaluation result metrics including score, correctness, performance, and adaptability
refactor_evaluate_timeout: refactor the evaluate function to adjust the build or run timeout thresholds
